reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds an animated SVG or emoji companion and synchronized status text to the Deep diving indicator, making visualization the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的“Deep diving...”状态提示添加带表情变化、动画效果和同步打字机文字的 SVG 或表情小伙伴。
summaries.en: Adds an animated SVG or emoji companion with changing expressions and synchronized typewriter text to the DeepSeek Harness “Deep diving...” status indicator.

capabilities: Injects an animated SVG avatar into the DeepSeek Harness web status indicator
Replaces the status text with synchronized typewriter messages
Observes relevant DOM mutations and updates the animation lifecycle
Reads localStorage settings for display mode, size, and emoji configuration
